note: l2_puzzleroom from checkpoint 2818, the upper east ledge. Pole 2967 (sa_pt_pole_a) starts inserted in the mechanism's hole 2969. Walking west its pick-up record reaches her (the autopilot's engage) and Interact pulls it out: she carries it, hole 2969 is empty, and the pole's script frees this side of the lift: elevator part 2960 vt 54, switch 2961 vt 62. Ours takes the pole from the ledge, 1085 from it [I]; the original has her jump up to hang on it first (matrix row C08-12).
